verdict.rationale: Zulip has its own documented REST API, described by a complete OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec and versioned through a feature-level changelog. It also has a bot framework, so programmatic access is clearly first-party. However, the pack only shows a few concrete endpoints (e.g., send a message) and nothing states that the API matches what the UI can do. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that every UI action is available via the API, an endpoint inventory covering admin, settings, channel and topic management, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The zulip/zulip repository ships a complete OpenAPI 3.0.1 description of the API, info title "Zulip REST API", at zerver/openapi/zulip.yaml.
Every API change is logged under a numbered feature level (e.g. "Feature level 513" for Zulip 13.0), which clients read from server responses to determine the API format in use.
Zulip’s API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip.
